name: Saudi Arabia
famous_for: Sacred holy cities of Mecca and Medina, ancient Nabataean rock tombs of Hegra in AlUla, vast Rub' al Khali desert, and Arabian horses.
tourists: Over 18.0M visitors; famous for AlUla Hegra tombs, historic Al-Balad district in Jeddah, and Edge of the World cliffs in Riyadh.
must_know: Hospitality is legendary; offering Arabic coffee (Gahwa) flavored with cardamom and sweet dates is the quintessential welcome.
fun_fact: The Rub' al Khali (Empty Quarter) desert in southern Saudi Arabia is the largest continuous sand desert on planet Earth.
